summary: Iteration 133 - ArrivalsCockpit (Contactless Guest Journey / Self-Service Kiosk command centre) fully tested. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all data-testid selectors working correctly.

features: window=7d filters to next 7 days (20 arrivals found)
window=all returns all upcoming arrivals (365 days)
Sets payment_status=paid and amount_paid=total_price on booking
Returns 400 if booking not paid (requires paid status first)
Upserts digital_keys collection with booking details
After calling, GET arrivals shows progress.key_issued=true and digital_key_code populated
Marks key status=revoked in digital_keys collection
Returns 404 if no key exists for booking
Full contactless journey: send-registration -> mark-paid -> issue-key -> revoke-key

data_testids_verified: arrivals-btn - Sidebar nav button for Arrivals Cockpit
arrivals-cockpit - Main component container
kpi-arrivals - KPI card showing total arrivals count
kpi-registered - KPI card showing registered count
kpi-id-verified - KPI card showing ID verified count
kpi-paid - KPI card showing paid count
kpi-keys - KPI card showing keys issued count
win-today - Window tab for today's arrivals
win-7d - Window tab for next 7 days
win-30d - Window tab for next 30 days
win-all - Window tab for all upcoming
arrivals-search - Search input for filtering arrivals
arrivals-table - Table showing arrivals list
send-{id} - Send registration link button per arrival
pay-{id} - Mark paid button per arrival
issue-{id} - Issue key button per arrival (shown when paid)
qr-{id} - QR code button per arrival (shown when link sent)
key-{id} - Key code chip per arrival (shown when key issued)
qr-modal - QR code modal with QRCodeSVG and copy link
key-modal - Digital key modal with code and revoke button
revoke-key - Revoke key button in key modal
features_verified: Hero section shows 'Contactless check-in, one pane.' with arrivals count and keys ready percentage
5 KPI cards with progress bars showing completion rates
Window tabs switch between today/7d/30d/all views
Search input filters arrivals by guest name/ref/email
Table shows guest info, check-in date, room, progress dots, action buttons
Progress dots show 5 stages: Link Sent -> Registered -> ID Verified -> Paid -> Key Issued
Action buttons appear based on stage (Send Link, Mark Paid, Issue Key, QR, Key code)
QR modal shows QRCodeSVG with registration URL and copy button
Key modal shows 8-char unlock code with expiry and Revoke button

critical_code_review_comments: All 4 arrivals endpoints properly protected with role-based authentication
issue-key correctly requires paid status before issuing (400 if unpaid)
Digital keys stored in MongoDB with 8-char alphanumeric codes
Progress calculation correctly aggregates from bookings, guest_registrations, and digital_keys collections
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
QRCodeSVG component renders registration QR codes correctly
MOCKED: Digital keys are stored in MongoDB but do NOT call any physical lock hardware
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded bookings (20 arrivals in 7d window). Backend tests modified some booking payment statuses and issued/revoked keys during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 133 added ArrivalsCockpit - a dedicated ops view for contactless guest journey. Four new endpoints: GET /api/arrivals/{pid} returns arrivals with progress tracking, POST mark-paid/issue-key/revoke-key for one-click actions. Frontend shows hero, 5 KPI cards, window tabs (today/7d/30d/all), search, table with progress dots and action buttons. QR modal shows registration QR code, key modal shows digital unlock code. Digital keys are MOCKED (stored in MongoDB, no physical lock API calls).

mocked_apis_list: digital_keys issuance (no physical lock API call) - keys stored in MongoDB but do NOT call any physical lock hardware
